title: A producer edits a shop that already exists

criteria.text: Owner edits image, name and about from one prefilled page
criteria.note: [V] Edit page Basics card prefills image, name and description (EditCards.tsx, #472, Reviewed by) and saves through group.update (#158, no Reviewed by line); deploy-health green on 1ebe680 and 614c920. Smoked: unknown, page-edit has no stable live address in smoke-live (skipped in every run, 10 skips on 2026-10-23). unmarked: src/actions/group/update.test.ts ('refuses a stranger', 'writes an event naming the fields that changed'); nothing asserts all three from one page. Check ticket #1006. Split from 1: the values line is 1b

criteria.text: A free-text values line on the same prefilled page
criteria.note: [V] no values field and no column; the 'Values & badges' card in EditCards.tsx is a 'Coming soon' placeholder (#465, planned not built). Conflict: the scenario's approved line and the 2026-09-07 ruling cut the values statement, yet the criterion text still names it. #16 was closed 2026-10-18 saying 'shop image, description and values are edited in the Page editor'; values are not. Routed to scope-scenario

criteria.text: Only an active owner can save; the write goes through a named handler with an event row
criteria.note: [V] group.update (src/actions/group/update.ts): managing role with left_at null, active/archived only, appends group.updated naming the fields. Built in #158 (no Reviewed by line); #944 (Reviewed by) added stops to the same handler; deploy-health green on 1ebe680 and 0083294. #990's claim flow makes a verified claimant the owner through group.claim_verify, not through this handler. Smoked: unknown, page-edit is skipped in smoke-live. unmarked: update.test.ts ('refuses a stranger', 'writes an event naming the fields that changed')

criteria.text: The values column has no source or provenance field; nothing but the owner's own edit can write it
criteria.note: [V] no values_statement column in supabase/migrations or src; tests/migrations-page-identity.test.ts asserts only that one migration does not add it. Same conflict as 1b: the values line is cut, so the column this guards does not exist. Routed to scope-scenario

criteria.text: A tagline of at most 120 characters, separate from the description, on card, profile and link preview
criteria.note: [V] no tagline column in supabase/migrations, no field in group.update or Edit, nothing in the Page's generateMetadata. TileCard takes a tagline prop but OwnPages passes the description into it. Ticket #584, no milestone

criteria.text: A Page with every optional field empty renders correctly, with nothing nagging
criteria.note: [V] ShopPublicPage omits an empty description, placement line, map, Contact and badge (sections built in #472, reworked by #926 and #944, all with Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 614c920, d453170, 0083294). Visitors never see an empty Products & services section (FeaturedItems returns null); the owner alone sees 'Add your first product or service' when the component is on and empty (#920) [A: whether that counts as nagging is for #845 to settle]. Smoked: unknown, smoke-live opens the first Page Explore lists, not one with every field empty. unmarked: ShopPublicPage.test.tsx ('omits it when empty', 'no empty heading, no placeholder'). Check ticket #845

criteria.text: On the draft or live Page, an address search resolves to real coordinates with a confirming pin before saving; an unresolvable address refuses loudly
criteria.note: [V] WhereFields + PinAdjustMap (#351, Reviewed by), 'Drop a pin' saves the map's coordinates (#441, Reviewed by); #944 (Reviewed by) rebuilt WhereFields as seven answers with 'Street address' keeping the search, pin and refusal; deploy-health green on 3492589, e79a69d, 0083294. With no map key the address is used as found and no map is drawn. Smoked: unknown, page-edit is skipped in smoke-live. unmarked: WhereFields.test.tsx ('says so when nothing matches the address'), PinAdjustMap.test.tsx, LocationPlaceFields.test.tsx

criteria.text: A neighbourhood or town from a seeded list covering MSA 40900 instead of an address; a neighbourhood-mode Page exposes no street address anywhere
criteria.note: [V] seeded boundaries (#350: 88 places, 165 neighbourhoods; no Reviewed by line); the pick in #351 and #468 (Reviewed by), now the 'Neighbourhood only' answer in #944 (Reviewed by); saves a neighborhoodId and no point (where-save.ts). deploy-health green on 32c0cdc, 3492589, d41939a, 0083294. Invariant: #944 and #926 added per-answer privacy tests ('an area-only Page never sends its exact point') but no standing guard over every surface that reads a Page's location (#586). Smoked: unknown. unmarked: where-save.test.ts, tests/boundaries-db.test.ts. Split from 7: the pin is 7b

criteria.text: A neighbourhood-mode Page shows as a pin at the neighbourhood's centre
criteria.note: [V] Overtaken by Don's 2026-10-18 ruling on #896 [for now] ('area only doesn't need a map to open but does need some kind of indicator'): since #944 the Page shows one line, 'In <neighbourhood>', with a location icon and no map; Explore's map still marks the area at its centroid as a disc (#475, pins.ts). Newer wins over the scenario's 2026-10-04 ruling ('as a pin at its centre'); sync-roadmap amends the scenario. Shown, not counted

criteria.text: Owner picks or creates tags in their own words, editable any time; no category and no 'Something else'; at least one tag to publish
criteria.note: [V] group.update replaces the tag set and refuses to leave none (#288, no Reviewed by line; deploy-health green on a5ab3a1); group.activate refuses a Page with no tags (T159). group.update still accepts a category field but no Edit or Create component offers one. Invariant (no category, no 'Something else'): no standing guard. Smoked: unknown. unmarked: update.test.ts ('refuses to leave a Page with no tags'), activate.test.ts, ShopPublicPage.test.tsx ('shows no category chip')

criteria.text: Optional public business phone, separate from the private phone, shown to members only by default
criteria.note: [V] groups.contact_phone granted to authenticated only (#305, no Reviewed by line; deploy-health green on 7381f60); #926 (Reviewed by; green on d453170) moved it into the Contact card, shown only when signed in ('signed out, no Contact at all' test). Text follows the 2026-10-07 ruling (phone defaults to members). Smoked: unknown. unmarked: tests/page-contact-db.test.ts ('never answer a signed-out caller'). Split from 9: the owner's switch is 9b

criteria.text: The owner can open the phone, and each contact field, to everyone with a per-field globe/lock switch
criteria.note: [V] 2026-10-07 ruling: each contact field carries everyone/members, phone and Contact email default to members. No visibility column, no switch and no Contact email in supabase/migrations or src; #926 notes 'no public email field in the schema'. Open Issue #480 (change, milestone After beta), so nothing new filed
